You are the cold reviewer in the po-output-check process, step screen, round 1 (fresh context). Read only the three files named here — nothing else.

- criteria_path: /home/vscode/rebaseline/basis/fitness/backlog-order.fitness.md
- framing: /home/vscode/rebaseline/roadmap.md (the PM role's recorded priority — the framing this order is checked against)
- artifact: /home/vscode/rebaseline/backlog/order-2026-09-04.md

Step prompt (verbatim): "State, as judge_stamp, the model and prompt version you judge as. Read the criteria set at criteria_path, the framing at framing, and the artifact at artifact — nothing else. Judge the artifact against every criterion and against the framing: does each part of it trace to the framing, and does anything in it serve no framed outcome? Report every finding with the criterion it fails by name — "framing" for a part that does not trace to the framing or serves no framed outcome — the quoted text, the change, and whether you could decide it (confident) or not (wobbly); for a wobbly finding quote the whole passage, since the PM role decides from the review alone. A defect no criterion names is a finding with criterion "uncovered". Verdict "clean" only if there are no findings; otherwise "findings" with the top three changes."

Return exactly this structure:
judge_stamp: <model id> / screen prompt v6
verdict: clean | findings
findings:
- criterion: <scenario name or number, "framing", or "uncovered">
  section: <section of the artifact>
  quoted: "<the text>"
  change: <what would repair it>
  decided: confident | wobbly
top_three: <the three most important changes, or "none">

Be literal to the criteria. Do not invent criteria. Do not read any other file.

The PM role's recorded priority, which every backlog order is placed
against (the backlog-order typedef's `priority` link). No roadmap

record exists because the backlog-order typedef requires a recorded
